**Notable finding to flag:** `every_rule_that_fires_names_the_file_it_fired_on` (a4.rs:117-146) has three separate issues — t2 (weak `is_empty` check doesn't verify correct file attribution), t5 (hard-coded rule-id list instead of sweeping `violations`) — and `a_missing_clone_exits_4_stale_not_a_gap` reads the real `HOME` env var (t4 violation).
